messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: billing-metering / token-count-drift — severity P2. Customers may see transient overage flags. Rule: delta > 5% over baseline for 30m. Link: https://redwood.inc/ops/alerts/1761212121
Matt (oncall): ack. Investigating. Checking emitter metrics + ingestion window.
Alex (infra): I see delayed Kafka consumer lag on topic billing-usage-raw, consumer group metering-ingest-c1 at ~340k lag. Could explain late reports.
Sara (billing-eng): Confirming we also see ~4% token uplift in ingest counts vs pre-agg. Might be duplication/replay.
Matt (oncall): running quick query to compare raw vs deduped counts for a sample_customer_id=acct_42
Matt (oncall): ```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM billing.raw_usage
WHERE ts >= now()-interval '2 hours' AND customer_id='acct_42';
-- raw: 1,020,000
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM billing.fingerprint_dedup
WHERE ts >= now()-interval '2 hours' AND customer_id='acct_42';
-- deduped: 980,000
```
Matt (oncall): raw > deduped by ~4%, matches Sara. Likely replay from emitter shard. Which emitter pool? Alex?
Alex (infra): proxy-emitter-01 had a reconnect storm at 2026-03-18T02:14Z, see logs. It retried with idempotency disabled for a short window.
Alex (infra): ```
[02:14:12] proxy-emitter-01 WARN reconnect backoff=200ms retries=7 idempotency=off
[02:14:13] proxy-emitter-01 INFO push to kafka partition=12 offset=4012345
```
Lia (support): We have two customers flagged for overage alerts: acct_42 and acct_99, both got automated emails. Priya (CS) heads-up.
Priya (CS): pinged both; will draft hold message if it's internal. Do we have a rollback/mitigation plan?
Sara (billing-eng): short-term mitigation: pause overage-alerts downstream flagging rule for 'quietburst' class for 15m. I'm preparing a feature flag.
Matt (oncall): I'll throttle emitter and trigger dedupe backfill. Steps: (1) flip emitter-idempotency to on; (2) pause retry queue; (3) trigger dedupe job.
Matt (oncall): ```
# flip feature flag
rbacctl set feature emitter_idempotency=true --target proxy-emitter-01
# pause retry queue
kafka-ctl pause-consumer metering-retries
# backfill dedupe
run ./jobs/dedupe_backfill --customer acct_42,acct_99 --window 3h
```
Alex (infra): Making small config change now (oncall-approved). Pushing change.
incident-bot: Change detected: emitter-idempotency=true by Alex (infra). Notifying oncall.
Matt (oncall): After the change, consumer lag dropped from ~340k to ~2k over 7m. Monitoring token diff.
Sara (billing-eng): dedupe job completed for sample customers; raw vs deduped now consistent within 0.2%.
Lia (support): Paused automatic overage emails; sent manual note to acct_42 and acct_99: 'We're investigating transient billing alerts, avoiding any immediate charges.'
Priya (CS): customers acknowledged. No P0 escalation.
Matt (oncall): Will keep monitoring for 45m. If stable, we'll close the pager and create follow-up postmortem.
Alex (infra): I'll open a ticket to investigate root cause of emitter reconnect storm and add stricter idempotency defaults.
incident-bot: Pager resolved at 1761212800 — Severity P2 -> mitigated. Create followup: /incidents create 1761212121-metering-token-replay
